name: Kelden Site Hard-Knee Construction Pant
description: Reinforced construction trousers with integrated hard-cap knee panels that absorb impact on concrete and rebar. The body is a sand-colored or earth-brown stretch canvas that allows crouching and climbing without binding. Comes with a hammer loop, three cargo pockets, and a front slot for a small tool roll.
functionality: Integrated hard-cap knee protection, hammer loop, tool roll pocket
what_it_says: Construction trade, probably mid-level — you invested in decent gear because your knees matter for another thirty years.
story_hooks: Kelden hard-cap panels can be swapped out; workers sometimes replace the knee inserts with non-standard materials — or remove them to hide compartments in the knee pockets.
A construction crew where everyone wears matching Kelden pants probably works for one of the larger corponation build contractors, which means they have site access codes and shift schedules.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sturdy, utilitarian work pant with a straight leg and pronounced knee reinforcement. Silhouette reads as practical and grounded—designed for labor, not aesthetics. The hard-cap knee panels create a subtle but visible bulge at the kneecap, giving the wearer a slightly mechanical appearance.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through hip and thigh with strategic stretch for mobility. Tapered slightly at ankle. Waistband sits at natural hip height. Designed for layering over compression underlayers or thermal base wear.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-duty stretch canvas (85% recycled polyfiber, 15% organic cotton blend), treated with hydrophobic coating. Knee panels are molded impact-absorbing polymer composite with ballistic weave backing.
physical_description.texture: Canvas body has a slightly nubbed, worn surface with visible weave pattern. Knee panels are smooth and slightly glossy, contrasting sharply with the matte body fabric. Edges show intentional reinforcement stitching.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: sand beige or warm earth brown. Knee panels in darker charcoal or gunmetal. Stitching in contrasting tan or copper tone. Minor fading and dirt stains are expected.
physical_description.closures: Five-point reinforced button fly with secondary magnetic closure for durability. Heavy-gauge coated zipper rated for repetitive use.
distinctive_features: Molded hard-cap knee panels with visible impact-absorption ridges
Three oversized cargo pockets (thigh and hip placement)
Hammer loop on right hip in reinforced nylon webbing
Front utility slot for small tool roll or cable storage
Reinforced crotch panel and seat in ballistic weave
Reflective piping along side seams for low-light visibility
Kelden Site logo (embroidered) on rear right waistband
Pre-existing wear patterns: scuff marks, minor fraying at hem
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional working class. Not cheap or salvaged, but unambiguously practical and utilitarian.
physical_description.cultural_context: Construction worker, site crew, logistics handler, or manual labor professional in the GLMZ. Signals reliability, physical labor, and corpo-adjacent industrial work. Worn by people who climb, crouch, and move heavy objects for salary.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and weathered. Knees show darkening from repeated impact and abrasion. Canvas body has oil stains, concrete dust residue, and minor fraying. Still functional and regularly re-treated with hydrophobic coating.
